messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: AUTOPAGER: PagerDuty PD-10233 fired for node-rt-23 (gpu-host). Alert: kernel_panic detected, kubelet NotReady. 3 auto-pings sent. Link: https://pagerduty.example/PD-10233

alex: ACK PD-10233 — I'm on the wire. starting triage. tagging @priya if I need handoff.

incident-bot: autopager: no human progress seen in 3m, escalating to next on-call: @priya. Suppressing further identical pages for 5m.

priya: I'm awake, taking over. quick summary? customer-facing impact?

sam: Watching metrics — ingress 5xxs from inference-service-usw2 up ~3.8% in the last 2m, 99p latency for generation routes spiked to ~18s. Top affected tenant: neo-sim (long-batch), also a couple of short-lived jobs from dataflow-proto. Dashboard: https://grafana.example/d/inf

alex: Node-level notes — node-rt-23 = gpu:a100-80gb, kernel log shows immediate oops then panic. kubelet moved to NotReady. Some pods stuck Terminating (local-ssd backed caches). dmesg snippet:
```
[  123.456789] Kernel panic - not syncing: internal fatal exception
[  123.456790] Call Trace:
[  123.456791]  dump_stack+0x45/0x5f
[  123.456792]  panic+0x101/0x2f0
[  123.456793]  nmi_watchdog+0x8f/0xa0
```
kubectl view (partial):
```
$ kubectl get pods -o wide --field-selector spec.nodeName=node-rt-23
inference-cache-redis-0   Running    1/1   node-rt-23   10.2.3.45
batch-runner-neo-1        Terminating 0/1   node-rt-23   10.2.3.46
embeddings-worker-57      Running    1/1   node-rt-23   10.2.3.47
```

alex: Actions I'm running now:
- `kubectl cordon node-rt-23`
- attempt `kubectl drain node-rt-23 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --timeout=5m` to move workloads.
- collecting `journalctl -b -1 -u kubelet` and nvme logs.

priya: Ok. before force-evicting anything, let's warm-failover traffic to dedicated-fallback-west group so we don't surge other shared pools. I'm going to shift routing to the fallback pool now (console + CLI).

priya: Running: `redwood route update --service inference-usw2 --to-group dedicated-fallback-west --weight 100` (simulated CLI). Routing change applied, gradual cutover set to 30s windows.

sam: After routing change: 503s drop to baseline in ~45s, 99p latency trending back down to ~600ms for gen routes. Embeddings still lagging (~2s) — likely cache warmups.

alex: Drain is hitting a stuck pod: inference-cache-redis-0 has PVC on local-ssd and won't evict. Trying `kubectl delete pod inference-cache-redis-0 --grace-period=30 --force` to free up. If that fails, we'll rebuild cache on fallback nodes.

jordan-sre: I'm SRE, jumping in to coordinate hardware follow-through. From journald + nvme vendor logs this looks like a PCIe/heat-related fault we've seen before. I'll open an RMA and tag host for replacement. ETA from colo vendor ~3h.

jordan-sre: Runbook items executed:
- traffic shifted to fallback pool (priya)
- node cordoned & drain attempted (alex)
- forced eviction for ephemeral pods (alex)
- opened PD incident with summary + RMA ticket (PD-10233 + RMA-4578)

priya: Customer impact note: neo-sim batch jobs had ~6 in-flight tasks, 2 failed mid-run (we'll surface retry guidance). Notifying CS & Customer-Impact channel now. Message sent to #customer-impact with tenant list and suggested mitigation.

sam: Quick metric snapshot after mitigation: overall request rate stable, error budget burn stopped. Cache hit rate on embeddings down from 98% -> 60% (expected while cache warms on fallback).

alex: stepping through forced deletions for remaining stuck pods. Example command used:
```
kubectl delete pod batch-runner-neo-1 --grace-period=30 --force --namespace=prod
```
some pods re-created on fallback pool successfully.

priya: Posting update to status page: "Partial degraded performance for embeddings in us-west-2; routing applied to fallback pool. ETA remediation ~3h while host is RMA'd." Link: https://status.redwood.example/incidents/PD-10233

jordan-sre: Noted. We'll mark node-rt-23 as decommissioning once vendor picks up. Will also run soak tests on replacement node before rejoining cluster. I'll document kernel oops signature in postmortem template.

alex: handing off primary on-call to priya. I'm available for 10 more minutes for any questions, then dropping out to handle other pager queue.

priya: taking over. I've added followups: postmortem owner = jordan-sre, customer outreach = CS (contacted), infra ticket = RMA-4578. I'll run a quick runbook check and update PD timeline.

incident-bot: PD-10233 update: acknowledged by alex at 1788889999, reassigned to priya at 1788890022, autopager suppressed. Watchers added: @eng-sre, @customer-success.

sam: All green from metrics POV except embeddings cache warming — will keep an eye for 30m. Great coordination team. :thumbsup:

priya: closing note for handoff — if embed latency doesn't recover in 40m, escalate traffic to regional cold-pool and open immediate postmortem prep. For now keeping node-rt-23 cordoned and decommissioning flagged.

jordan-sre: I'll follow up with hardware vendor and schedule the replacement. Will link postmortem draft in incident ticket.

priya: thanks all — updating PD status and closing this Slack thread for now, will re-open if anything else pops.

incident-bot: Incident PD-10233 status: active -> monitoring. Next update by 1788890400 or on significant change."
